findings.title: Missing Security Header: Content-Security-Policy
findings.evidence: Header 'Content-Security-Policy' was not returned by https://www.saucedemo.com/
findings.impact: Prevents Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) and unauthorized script execution.
findings.remediation: Define a strict Content-Security-Policy header restricting script-src and default-src.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: Strict-Transport-Security
findings.evidence: Header 'Strict-Transport-Security' was not returned by https://www.saucedemo.com/
findings.impact: Enforces HTTPS connections and protects against protocol downgrade attacks.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: X-Frame-Options
findings.evidence: Header 'X-Frame-Options' was not returned by https://www.saucedemo.com/
findings.impact: Protects users against Clickjacking attacks via embedded iframes.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: X-Content-Type-Options
findings.evidence: Header 'X-Content-Type-Options' was not returned by https://www.saucedemo.com/
findings.impact: Stops browsers from MIME-sniffing responses away from declared Content-Type.

findings.title: Missing Security Header: Referrer-Policy
findings.evidence: Header 'Referrer-Policy' was not returned by https://www.saucedemo.com/
findings.impact: Controls how much referrer URL information is leaked to external origins.

findings.title: Technology Stack Disclosure via 'Server' Header
findings.impact: Reveals exact server/framework versions to aid targeted exploit selection.
findings.remediation: Strip or obfuscate the 'Server' response header at the reverse proxy/server level.

findings.title: Accessible Sensitive Resource: /robots.txt
findings.impact: Public crawler directives that may reveal hidden administrative routes.
findings.remediation: Restrict public web access to '/robots.txt' via web server rules or remove it from the web root.
